title: Polynitrogen Clusters Containing Five-Membered Rings
authors: Cheng L.P., Li S., Li Q.S.
notes_general: Comparison structures shown for N8/N10/N11/N12/N13/N14 in Figures 3-4 are reproductions of OTHER papers already cited (ref 1 = Glukhovtsev/Schleyer = poly-N.pdf already in existing corpus; ref 21 = Manaa = N10-N60.pdf in this archive; ref 22 = Klapotke/Harcourt = N12-N8.pdf in this archive) -- NOT extracted here as new species, only this paper's own novel contribution (9 N15 isomers) is captured. Figures 1-2 contain full 2D bond-length/bond-angle labeled diagrams (3 levels of theory each: B3PW91/B3LYP/MP2, plus Wiberg bond indices) for each N15 isomer -- precise per-atom-pair transcription was NOT attempted here (risk of misreading atom-to-atom correspondence from a dense hand-labeled figure); a dedicated high-resolution re-read of Figures 1-2 could upgrade these from topology_only to bond_params if exact reconstruction is later wanted. All values below (topology, point group, energies, ZPE, imaginary-mode count) are taken directly from the paper's Tables I-III and prose (all pure text, no figure-reading involved for these).

species.method: B3LYP/6-31G* + B3PW91/6-31G* + MP2/6-31G* (geometry+freq at DFT levels)
species.source_note: Table I-III, Figure 1 (isomer 15-1), most stable N15 isomer

bond_params.shape: two pentazole (N5) rings connected by a 5-atom chain; most bond lengths close to aromatic N-N 1.350 A, one N-N close to double-bond 1.252 A

species.notes: Most stable of 9 N15 isomers (0.0 kcal/mol reference not used here, but lowest E in Table I at all 3 levels). n_imaginary=0 (true minimum). E(B3LYP)=-820.8360 Ha, ZPE=42.2 kcal/mol. Dissociation energy to 15/2 N2: 388.5 (B3LYP) / 490.5 (MP2) kcal/mol.
